text: dsh-session-guard 是一款 DSH 会话保护插件，通过在会话开始和每个 agent 步骤前获取按会话区分的本地锁，避免多个 DSH 进程同时写入同一会话日志。它会检测已有锁的进程与心跳状态，拒绝冲突写入，并在持有锁期间定时刷新心跳；进程退出时释放自己持有的锁，死进程或过期的外部主机锁可被接管。用户可选择 enforce 阻止冲突步骤，或用 warn 仅记录提示。适合同时运行 Web、CLI 或多个 DSH 实例并共享会话目录的用户。锁文件默认写入 DSH_HOME/session-locks，未设置时使用 ~/.dsh；不需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

dsh-session-guard adds per-session locks to DSH. It checks ownership before agent steps, blocks or warns on concurrent writes, refreshes locks, and can take over stale locks. Files are stored under DSH_HOME/session-locks or ~/.dsh. No API key or external service is needed.
多个 DSH 进程同时运行时，怎么避免它们写坏同一个会话日志？
DSH 的 Web 和命令行共用会话时，怎样减少并发写入冲突？
How can I prevent two DSH processes from writing the same session at once?
dsh-session-guard 的功能「会话并发写入保护」：会话开始和每个 agent 步骤前尝试获取会话锁；遇到存活的锁持有者时按 enforce 模式阻止步骤，或按 warn 模式记录提示。
dsh-session-guard 的功能「失效锁接管」：发现同机进程已退出，或无法验证的外部主机心跳超时后，替换旧锁并继续保护该会话。

[中文文档](README.zh.md) · Companion: [dsh-session-rescue](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-session-rescue) (repairs the damage this plugin prevents)

@po-et/dsh-session-guard README · dsh-session-guard：The most common dsh corruption family is concurrent writing: a `dsh web` plus a CLI, two instances on different ports, or a desktop shell sharing one `$DSH_HOME`. Each process keeps its own in-memory seq cursor, the second writer lands events with already-committed seqs, and the session becomes permanently unloadable:

```
history unavailable for session "…": corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region …
```

@po-et/dsh-session-guard README · dsh-session-guard：dsh has no cross-process lock today. This plugin adds one — advisory, per-session, with automatic takeover of dead owners — so the conflicting step **fails loudly with an actionable message instead of silently destroying your history**.

@po-et/dsh-session-guard README · Install：> Not on npm yet, so install straight from GitHub. pnpm will ask you to allow this package's build script once (dsh prints the exact line to add); that's the `prepare` step compiling TypeScript.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:po-et/dsh-session-guard
```

Using an AI agent? Tell it: *"Install the dsh-session-guard plugin into my dsh."*

@po-et/dsh-session-guard README · What you see when it saves you：```
Error: session-guard: session session-37374e34… is already being written by another
dsh process (pid 84231 on mbp.local, held 42s, last heartbeat 3s ago). Two writers
on one session corrupt its log ("seq gap in committed region"). Close that process
or use a different session; a dead owner’s lock is taken over automatically …

text: @po-et/dsh-session-guard README · What you see when it saves you：The step fails; the log stays intact; nothing is lost. Crashed processes never wedge a session: a lock whose owner pid is gone is taken over instantly, and unverifiable owners (other hosts on a shared home) expire after 90s without a heartbeat.

```yaml
- id: session-guard
  name: "@po-et/dsh-session-guard"
  config:
    mode: enforce        # 'enforce' (default) fails conflicting steps; 'warn' only logs

@po-et/dsh-session-guard README · Honest boundary：- The lock is **advisory**: it protects dsh processes that load this plugin. A process without it is not restrained (install the plugin in every profile you run).
- It guards the **active turn-write path** (`agent/session-start`, `agent/pre-step`). The cold-load repair path that commits synthetic interrupt-closers before any step runs is inside dsh itself and cannot be intercepted from a plugin — that fix needs to land upstream.
- Locks live under `$DSH_HOME/session-locks`; deployments overriding the session root elsewhere in config still key locks by home + session id.
- If corruption already happened, this plugin can't undo it — [dsh-session-rescue](https://github.com/po-et/dsh-session-rescue) can.
